shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' /home/sandbox 2>/dev/null | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install react-markdown remark-gfm lucide-react'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button'
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"try { console.log(require.resolve('playwright')) } catch {} try { console.log(require.resolve('@playwright/test')) } catch {}\" && ls /tmp && git diff --stat"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --no-save @playwright/test && npx playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apt-get; command -v dpkg-deb; ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/browser-libs && cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libxrender1 libxi6'

/bin/bash -lc 'for archive in /tmp/browser-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/browser-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell | rg '"'not found'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libwayland-server0 && dpkg-deb -x libwayland-server0*.deb /tmp/browser-libs/root'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core && for archive in fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/browser-libs/root; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libbrotli1 && for archive in libfontconfig1*.deb libfreetype6*.deb libpng16-16*.deb libbrotli1*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/browser-libs/root; done'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '80,180p' src/App.tsx && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libfontconfig.so.1'

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libsoftokn3.so | rg 'not found'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 && dpkg-deb -x libsqlite3-0*.deb /tmp/browser-libs/root'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check'
